values.note: Online reservations ran 5/18-9/13 in 2026; from 9/14 through the park's close all sites are first-come. Up to 14 nights per reservation. Call center 800-332-1501. Sites marked with a triangle on the map, such as 14, 38, 45, 48, 57, 62, 74, 86, 92, 98, 109 and 110, aren't reservable.

hookups.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/parksearch/ (park_id=14) ('RV hookup (electric and water)') + https://cg-public-prod.web.maine.gov/cg/cgimages/camden.jpg (shaded electric + water sites), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Map classes: S up to 20 ft, M up to 25, L up to 30, X up to 35, U over 35. Numbered to 110; sites 54 and 65 are administrative. Group camping is in the day-use area across Route 1.
Wi-Fi for a fee at select campsites.

facilities.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/parksearch/ (park_id=14) (RV dumping station, Showers, Wireless internet access) + https://cg-public-prod.web.maine.gov/cg/cgimages/camden.jpg ('Trailer Dumping Station', drinking water, showers, restrooms; Wi-Fi 'for a fee at select campsites'), read 2026-11-02

summary: Fees and season stand. Added water hookups, showers, dump, drinking water, wifi with caveat, length classes, some sites FCFS, 14-night cap. Note kept. Waterfront lead: coastal woods -> not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT lead: coastal woods -> not waterfront, going down without asking. The park's map runs US Route 1 along the campground's east edge with the shore beyond ('Group camping in day-use area across Route 1'), and imagery shows the highway in the frame E of the campground. AWH's rule: a highway between rules out coastal woods. The stored note itself says 'Park is on the bay but campsites do not appear to be waterfront'.
